title: Dimension drop for a principal Cartier subscheme of an affine variety
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and let $A$ be a nonzero finitely generated $k$-algebra such that $\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-pc-integral-scheme] is integral and of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. If $f\in A$ is nonzero and not a unit, then the affine scheme $\operatorname{Spec}(A/(f))$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-pc-scheme] satisfies $\dim(\operatorname{Spec}(A/(f)))+1=\dim(\operatorname{Spec}(A))$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension].

source.place: Tags 00KV and 00KW (Krull principal ideal and height theorems), together with the finite-type dimension formula Tag 02FX

proof.text: Use affine_isIntegral_iff to obtain IsDomain A. Finite type over the field k makes A Noetherian by Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing. The nonzero f is a nonzerodivisor. Since f is not a unit, (f) is proper; choose a maximal ideal m containing (f).

Apply finiteTypeDomain_ringKrullDim_localizationAtMaximal to m to obtain dim A_m = dim A. Rewrite dim A_m as the height of m using IsLocalization.AtPrime.ringKrullDim_eq_height. Thus m is a prime of full height containing f.

Apply the full-height principal quotient theorem to f and m. It gives dim(A/(f)) + 1 = dim A. Change the spectra to PrimeSpectrum and rewrite both topological dimensions using PrimeSpectrum.topologicalKrullDim_eq_ringKrullDim.
